name: X-ray repair cross complementing 1

function.text: XRCC1 encodes DNA repair protein XRCC1. Annotated molecular activities include 3' overhang single-stranded DNA endonuclease activity and poly-ADP-D-ribose binding. It participates in regulation of DNA repair and base-excision repair.

function.text: XRCC1 encodes DNA repair protein XRCC1. It is a scaffold protein involved in DNA single-strand break repair by mediating the assembly of DNA break repair protein complexes. It negatively regulates ADP-ribosyltransferase activity of PARP1 during base-excision repair in order to prevent excessive PARP1 activity. It recognizes and binds poly-ADP-ribose chains: specifically binds auto-poly-ADP-ribosylated PARP1, limiting its activity.
